name: Keto Broccoli Cheddar Quiche
ingredients_verbatim: 1 recipe Almond flour pie crust (omit sweetener, use extra salt)
why: Egg + cheddar custard quiche, vegetarian, published 573 cal / 23.2g protein / 13.3g total carbs (6.5g net) - inside the band though at the upper-calorie edge (our computed macros could push past 650, note as a risk). Almond-flour pie crust is the deliberate unmapped ingredient to exercise the pricer lane; it is also the one part that makes this quiche-with-crust rather than a pure crustless bake. Everything else maps (broccoli, eggs, heavy-cream, shredded cheddar, garlic). Included flagged so the selector can decide.
